entries.prompt:
Photoreal teaching display, TWO horizontal panoramic photographs STACKED vertically (one column,two rows). Overall aspect4:3, ideally2048x1536. Each photograph8:3. No gutters. Both show same scientifically precise molecular-polarity comparison from attached corrected SVG: top warm wood, bottom coolgray labbench.
Each photo has one LARGE open cream worksheet with two side-by-side labeled molecular diagrams and a small clear water bowl at far right under "VECTOR SUM" card. All evidence within central90%width/upper80%height, bottom20%quietbench.
LEFT diagram H2O: ONE red oxygen, TWO white hydrogens belowleft/right, clearly BENT. Two blue lone-pair lobes above O, each EXACTLY TWO dark dots. The TWO orange O-H BOND DIPOLE ARROWS point diagonally INWARD AND UPWARD from white H atoms toward the RED OXYGEN. Arrowheads at the red oxygen, tails/crosses at white hydrogens. A separate LONG resultant arrow points vertically UP above O. The reference depicts the required correct arrow direction. Label "H₂O", "THEY ADD", "POLAR".
RIGHT diagram CO2: black carbon between two red oxygen spheres in a straight horizontal line, equal orange dipole arrows point outward LEFT and RIGHT so they cancel. Label "CO₂", "THEY CANCEL", "NONPOLAR".
Make ARROW DIRECTION scientifically clear and large: water arrows converge toward O, never diverge toward H. Models/diagrams printed on actual paper, not floating in air. No extra spheres/electrons/arrows, no appfootercaption, no people/logos/watermark.
entries.review: Both water O-H arrows point from H toward O, net arrow upward,2lone pairs with2dots each; linearCO2 equal/opposite arrows cancel. LabelsTHEY ADD/POLAR andTHEY CANCEL/NONPOLAR correctly associated. Generated against corrected underlying SVG, whose prior water arrows were reversed.
